//: Capability manifest for toast/1 — keen-pure-admin. See alert.map.json / badge.map.json for the model. Maps each NEUTRAL toast feature to this wrapper's assign, kind, and (for enums) the option set THIS component declares. keen's toast has only the 5 severity variants (no secondary/light/dark). `filled` → is_filled; `show` → is_visible (drives pa-toast--show AND the :if that renders the toast); `close` → on_close (the dismiss event name — keen renders .pa-toast__close only when on_close is wired, so scenarios pass it). keen's toast/1 auto-derives the icon glyph from the variant but renders the :icon slot content when given. An :actions slot was added to toast/1 to match the blessed snippet (see fixture wrapper-bug note).
